correctness.rationale: Under the source's own skew multiplication, \(g_2=x+1\) has prime-field coefficients and therefore \((1+x^2)g_2=x^3+x^2+x+1=g_3\). Hence the product-ring code contains \(c=(0,g_3,g_3)\). At every one of its four ring coordinates the row is \((0,1,1)\), and right multiplication by the printed Gray matrix gives \((0,1,0)\). Thus the Gray image contains an explicit word of Hamming weight \(4\), disproving the published distance \(6\). Fresh exhaustive reconstruction of the \(5\)-dimensional quaternary image gives rank \(5\), all \(4^5=1024\) words, weight enumerator \(1+9z^4+72z^6+243z^8+384z^9+216z^{10}+99z^{12}\), and minimum distance \(4\). Independent column-subspace enumeration gives maxima \((0,1,2,4,8)\) and generalized Hamming weights \((4,8,10,11,12)\).
